slot.brief: A charged particle enters a magnetic field at some angle; identify the direction of magnetic force and whether the speed changes, using right-hand rule.

stem: A proton enters a uniform magnetic field with vertically upward velocity. The field is directed $30^\circ$ above the horizontal towards north. The magnetic force on the proton is directed towards the:
options: west, and its speed remains constant
east, and its speed remains constant

verdicts.working: For a proton, \(\vec F=q\,\vec v\times\vec B\). With upward velocity and a northward field component, the force points west. Magnetic force is perpendicular to velocity, so speed remains constant.

working:
$\vec v\times\vec B=\hat k\times(B\cos30^\circ\,\hat j+B\sin30^\circ\,\hat k)=-B\cos30^\circ\,\hat i$ (west). For a proton, $\vec F=q(\vec v\times\vec B)$ points west. Since $\vec F\perp\vec v$, the speed remains constant.
